title: Prison and Probation Ombudsman Deaths in Custody AI Deep-Dive Pack
description: DEFONEOS — Prison and Probation Ombudsman Deaths in Custody AI Deep-Dive Pack. A sovereign, audit-grade CSOAI surface: measurement, not certification — every figure traces to a signed, verifiable record.

sections.name: Death in Custody Investigation
sections.description: independent investigation of all deaths in prison, young offender institution, immigration removal centre, and approved premises

sections.name: Serious Harm & Self-Harm Review
sections.description: review of serious incidents of self-harm and violence in custody requiring independent oversight

sections.name: Prisoner Complaints Adjudication
sections.description: investigation of unresolved prisoner complaints about treatment, conditions, and access to services

sections.name: Probation Supervision Complaints
sections.description: investigation of complaints about probation supervision, recall decisions, and community order compliance

sections.name: Immigration Detention Oversight
sections.description: independent investigation of deaths and complaints in immigration removal centres

sections.name: Learning Lessons & Recommendations
sections.description: issuing formal recommendations to HMPPS to prevent recurrence of systemic failures

sections.name: Family Liaison & Communication
sections.description: providing independent information to families of those who die in custody

sections.name: Thematic Investigations
sections.description: systemic reviews of recurring safety and welfare issues across the prison estate

sections.name: Annual Reporting to Parliament
sections.description: publication of annual statistics and thematic reports on deaths and complaints

sections.name: Prevention of Future Deaths
sections.description: working with coroners and HMPPS to implement prevention of future death recommendations

sections.name: Vulnerable Prisoner Safeguarding
sections.description: focused oversight of mental health, neurodiversity, and vulnerability in custody

sections.name: Governance & Independence
sections.description: ensuring operational independence from HMPPS and MOJ in all investigative functions

backbone_legislation: Prison Act 1952 / Coroners and Justice Act 2009
